evals.prompt: Add Callout and Gallery Blocks to the article editor.
evals.expected_output: Append one official BlocksFeature through extendFeatures and verify Payload config.
expectations: Keeps project Blocks schemas outside the package.

evals.prompt: Replace the managed link feature with a native LinkFeature using custom fields.
evals.expected_output: Disable semantic link first, then append the native replacement.
expectations: Tests the replacement through the public interface.

evals.prompt: Pass an AI SDK client and secret key as client feature props.
evals.expected_output: Reject secret/function serialization and require a separate authenticated server contract.
expectations: Keeps provider SDKs out of client code.
Does not add AI to the core capability bag.

evals.prompt: Payload silently keeps the last of two custom feature providers with the same key.
evals.expected_output: Trace provider keys and enforce pre-Payload duplicate errors.
expectations: Does not rely on Payload last-wins behavior.

evals.prompt: Restrict link collections using the standard semantic option.
evals.expected_output: Use core link.allowedCollections rather than a native extension.
expectations: Routes primary work to core configuration.
